extracted text: The paper discusses cast A356 aluminum alloy used to produce automobile wheels and other parts. The high strength of A356 alloy is mainly derived from precipitation hardening of fine Mg2Si phases. The material was received in the form of 10 × 90 × 400 mm cast plates. The plates were subjected to friction stir processing (FSP) under various parameters and some samples received post-FSP artificial aging at 438K (165°C) for 5 hours.
